Net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 244,002,491.40, down 8.95%; excluding non-recurring items RMB 224,673,939.34, down 12.34%. quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 margins and costs (annual report): gross margin 19.84%, down 1.52 percentage points; H2 gross margin 19.42%, down 2.24 points YoY and 0.88 points half on half, which the company attributes to lower selling prices on some products despite a richer customer and product mix; net margin 5.47%, down 1.59 points; operating expenses RMB 5.80 hundred million, up 30.88%, an expense ratio of 12.99%.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Honor Electronic annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Data center power segment, FY2025 (annual report): revenue RMB 2,015,471,005.67, up 38.15%, 45.17% of revenue (38.42% in 2024) and the main driver of growth; within it high-power data center power revenue RMB 12.99 hundred million, up 66.52%, rising to 64.47% of the segment. Segment gross margin 23.83%, down 1.21 points as competition cut some unit prices. The company says it is one of the few suppliers selling high-power server power supplies at scale.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Honor Electronic annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D and server power products (annual report): 2025 R&D spend RMB 299,069,258.17, up 40.68%, 6.70% of revenue (none capitalised); R&D staff 959, up 39.80%. Server power line-up: 800-3600W air-cooled CRPS, 1600-3500W immersion liquid-cooled power supplies, 3300-5500W custom GPU power supplies and centralized power systems. Completed in 2025: a 3600W server PSU (96.5% peak efficiency, 112W/inch3), a 5500W server PSU with a 33kW centralized power system (97.5%+ peak efficiency), an ATS dual-input 2U 60kW centralized power system (66kW system power) and an ATS dual-input 3300W PSU (over 97% peak efficiency); in progress: a 400Vdc-input high-power PSU targeting 97.5% peak efficiency for next-generation HVDC architectures.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D RMB 299,069,258.17 (+40.68%, 6.70% of revenue); 5500W PSU / 33kW system 97.5%+; 400Vdc PSU in development

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Honor Electronic annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity projects (annual report): the company has two overseas production bases, Vietnam and Mexico. Its 'annual 145 ten-thousand units data center power' project at Suzhou had RMB 4,883.11 ten-thousand invested by end-2025 (18.84% of planned) with a scheduled ready date of January 22, 2027. Major construction in progress at end-2025: Mexico plant construction (budget RMB 130,951,171.09, 41.19% complete) and the Vietnam new plant (budget RMB 22,575,954.25, 60.06% complete).
quarterly_data.figure: 145 ten-thousand units/year data center power project, 18.84% invested, ready January 22, 2027

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Honor Electronic annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report): the company names data center power its core growth engine, to be driven by AI; it plans to deepen work on high-power, high-density, high-efficiency server power with third-generation semiconductors, liquid-cooling-compatible designs and HVDC input, and follows a 'stable at home, breakthrough overseas' approach, accelerating overseas market expansion while keeping domestic share; in adapters it plans to add categories such as smart home and drones and raise share at existing large customers.
